body: The Medical Tourism Field Guide is the foundation volume of the Tabiji Field Guides — a calm, practical manual for the patient considering medical care across an international border.

It is not a ranking of countries, clinics, or destinations. It teaches you to verify the surgeon and anesthesia provider in the official register, decode an international quote, recognize the harm patterns the CDC, FDA and State Department have documented, and use a formal telemedicine second opinion.
Built around the Five Rules, the Seven Leverage Points, the Procedure Complexity Ladder, and a 20-Minute Safety Pause for readers about to send a deposit. Re-researched and updated every year.
